title: Seabiscuit Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: This 3 bedroom Charleston style cottage sleeps 10 and has undergone a full facelift in 2017.
description_expanded: Charleston-Style Beach Home in Seaside, Florida | Sleeps 10This beautifully updated Charleston-style beach home in Seaside, Florida, comfortably sleeps up to 10 guests and offers the perfect combination of coastal charm, modern comfort, and an exceptional location. Just a 3-minute walk to the beach, one block from the West Side Pool, and approximately a 4-minute walk to the Seaside Amphitheater, this spacious vacation rental places you within easy walking distance of Seaside's beaches, pools, shopping, dining, and iconic town center.Seaside Vacation Rental Near the Beach, West Side Pool & AmphitheaterLocation is one of this home's greatest advantages. Spend the morning walking three minutes to the beach, enjoy an afternoon at the nearby West Side Pool, then stroll into Seaside for dinner, shopping, live music, or an evening at the Amphitheater. The home's convenient location makes it easy to experience everything Seaside has to offer.Designed in a modified “dog trot” architectural style, the home is thoughtfully arranged across two levels, with separate sleeping accommodations on the first floor and the primary living spaces and primary bedroom upstairs. Multiple screened porches, outdoor gathering spaces, and an open-air rooftop provide plenty of room for families and groups to relax together or find a quiet space of their own.Multiple Screened Porches & Outdoor LivingOutdoor living is a highlight of this Seaside vacation home. Multiple spacious screened porches provide comfortable places to enjoy the coastal breeze throughout the day. Just off the upstairs living room, a screened porch features conversational seating with rockers for four, creating an inviting spot for morning coffee, reading, or relaxing after a day at the beach.Continue down the expansive porch to another outdoor living area with dining for eight, making it an ideal setting for an al fresco family dinner, morning breakfast, or evening cocktails. The front outdoor area features Adirondack seating for three, a large picnic table, an enclosed outdoor shower, and a charcoal grill. After a day in the sand and surf, the outdoor shower provides an easy place to rinse off before heading inside.Sleeps 10 with Flexible Bedroom & Bunk AccommodationsThis Seaside vacation rental comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with a flexible combination of king bedrooms and bunk sleeping areas.The first floor features a fun bunk room with a twin bunk bed and a twin-over-double bunk, comfortably sleeping four guests. The room also includes a dresser and flat-screen TV. A shared full bathroom with a tub and shower combination is conveniently located nearby.Just down the hallway, a built-in twin bunk nook sleeps two additional guests and features individual mounted TVs, creating a fun and comfortable space for children or additional guests. The first floor also includes a king bedroom with its own private ensuite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower.Updated Kitchen & Dining Area for Family MealsThe updated kitchen is designed for both everyday convenience and gathering together. Stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and generous cabinet storage provide a functional space for preparing meals during your stay. The kitchen includes a large double-door refrigerator with water dispenser, microwave, dishwasher, and four-burner electric stovetop, along with plenty of cookware, dishes, and serving essentials.A breakfast bar seats three, while the adjacent dining area accommodates up to eight guests. The open configuration allows the kitchen, dining, and living spaces to flow naturally together, making it easy for everyone to gather for family meals, games, and conversation.Spacious Living Area with Dedicated WorkspaceThe open living area provides plenty of comfortable seating for the entire group, with an expansive wraparound sectional and two club chairs. Large windows fill the room with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming space to relax between beach outings.A large flat-screen TV is perfect for family movie nights or catching the game after a day exploring Seaside. A convenient half bathroom is located just off the main living area. For guests who need to work remotely during their stay, a dedicated built-in desk area near the dining space provides a convenient workspace.Private Primary King Suite with Screened PorchLocated at the rear of the second floor, the private primary suite features a king bed, large nightstands, generous storage, and a mounted flat-screen TV. The ensuite bathroom offers additional storage and a dressing area, along with a single vanity and an updated marble-and-glass enclosed walk-in shower.Just outside the primary bedroom, a private screened porch offers a peaceful retreat with a built-in bench and two club chairs. It is the perfect place to enjoy a quiet morning coffee, settle in with a good book, or relax with an evening cocktail for two.Rooftop Sunset Views Over SeasideOne of the home's most memorable features is its open-air rooftop perch, accessed by a spiral staircase from the main living area. With bench seating for two, this elevated outdoor space offers a unique place to take in the evening sky and watch the sunset over Seaside.After a day at the beach or exploring town, climb the spiral staircase and enjoy a quiet moment above the rooftops as the sun sets over the coast.Convenient Amenities for Your Seaside Beach VacationAdditional conveniences throughout the home include a full-size washer and dryer on the second floor, enclosed outdoor shower, charcoal grill, multiple screened porches, outdoor dining, private primary porch, rooftop seating, and convenient front parking. The combination of indoor and outdoor spaces gives families and groups plenty of room to spread out while enjoying the relaxed pace of a Seaside vacation.For additional room, the one-bedroom guest house, Grace Sea (in the rear), may also be rented. Or the full 4 bedroom combination of the two homes, Sandy Toes, can be rented.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURESFeatures 1,862 square feet3-minute walk (176 yards) to Seaside private residential beach access at Penascola Pavilion Two king bedroomsMedia and flat-screen TVs in every bedroomPrivate enclosed outdoor showerOutdoor charcoal grillPeacock Alley premium linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeLaundry room with full-size washer and dryerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002092
